claims: C1 the chain of command is designed to maximize steerability and control for users and developers
C2 it enables users and developers to adjust the model's behavior to their needs
C3 such adjustment stays within clear boundaries

concepts.name: chain_of_command_principle
concepts.gloss: the principle that instructions with higher authority override those with lower authority, designed to maximize steerability and control

concepts.name: maximizes_steerability_and_control
concepts.gloss: the design goal of the chain of command: maximizing the degree to which users and developers can steer and control the model

concepts.name: enables_behavior_adjustment
concepts.gloss: the chain of command enables users and developers to adjust the model's behavior to their needs

concepts.name: within_clear_boundaries
concepts.gloss: the adjustment of the model's behavior occurs within clear boundaries
